description: Powered by a 400 W motor, this HVLP (High Volume Low Pressure) sprayer delivers consistent and even paint coverage. Whether you're tackling walls, furniture, or other surfaces, the HVLP200-QS ensures a fine and controlled spray pattern for optimal results. The battery-powered operation adds flexibility, allowing you to move freely without the constraints of a power cord. The HVLP technology minimizes overspray, reducing paint wastage and ensuring a cleaner work environment. The adjustable spray pattern and flow control dial provide customization options, allowing you to achieve the desired finish for your specific project. From broad coverage to detailed work, this sprayer adapts to your painting needs. Designed with user convenience in mind, the HVLP200-QS is lightweight and easy to handle. The ergonomic design and comfortable grip make it suitable for both beginners and experienced painters. The 1.2 L paint container capacity minimizes the need for frequent refills, allowing you to cover larger areas without interruption. Cleaning up after your painting project is a breeze with the detachable design of the HVLP200-QS. The nozzle and paint container can be easily removed for quick and thorough cleaning. This feature not only saves time but also ensures that the sprayer is ready for future use. Warranty: 1 year from the date of purchase
